AB summary

NASA Space Apps Challenge is a global hackathon taking place on 14-15 November 2026. Participants use open data from NASA and partner space agencies to build projects addressing real-world problems.

The hackathon is open to all ages and skill levels. If there is no local event available, participants can join the virtual Universal Event. Participation is free, and teams may include up to 6 people.

Participants under 18 should review the parent or legal guardian rules. Before applying, confirm all participation requirements on the official registration page.

Eligibility

NASA Space Apps 2026 is open to all ages and skill levels. Participants under 18 should check the official rules for parent or legal guardian requirements.
